description.value: Mezbaan is an Indian and Indo-Chinese restaurant located on 96 Avenue in Surrey, BC. It offers a dual cuisine format blending South Asian and Indo-Chinese cooking traditions, a combination popular with diners seeking dishes like Manchurian and chilli preparations alongside traditional curries. Its position on a busy suburban arterial makes it a potential refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Surrey corridor.
